card.name: Words inside famous quoted phrases and lists
card.fires_on: A word in the middle of a well-known quote, title, name or list, often just before the next item or a repeated word. Examples are 'a canal' in the palindrome, 'Cursed be', and 'blood of bulls'.

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a personal name or title.
